get.description: Returns one or more media (queried via the `ids` parameter).

original.description: The identifier of the uploaded file to be used as the original component.

post.description: Uploads a file to be used for creating media.

type.description: Set to Url for URL upload.

url.description: The URL of the file to be uploaded.

id.description: The identifier of the uploaded file.

fb_post_as_reel.description: Whether to post as a reel on Facebook.

fb_post_as_story.description: Whether to post as a story on Facebook.

link_title.description: The title of the link associated with the message.

link_url.description: The URL of the link associated with the message.

media.description: List of media objects to attach to the message.

altText.description: The alternative text for the media.

id.description: The identifier of the media in the media system.

type.description: The mime type of the media.

videoFileZie.description: The size of the video file in bytes.

thumbnailOffset.description: Offset for the thumbnail in milliseconds.

message_text.description: The text content of the message.

send_to.description: Comma separated list of profile/profile list IDs.
